examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: Diminutive of ключ. Derived noun with agent/object suffix '-ник'/'-щик'/'-чик'. Common masculine noun meaning 'little key' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: In indirect questions. Core Russian part meaning 'whether, if; (что ли) or something' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: что ли — or something, or what?

examples.text: Вы что, меня покупаете, что ли?
examples.trans: What, are you buying me or something?

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!

meanings.note: + infinitive. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'can, to be able', paired with 'смочь'.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Надо + infinitive. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Её, ей, ей, о ней. Core Russian pron meaning 'she; it' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?

meanings.note: + dative of the person. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ветить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to answer, to reply', paired with 'отвечать'.
Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ветить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to answer, to reply', paired with 'отвечать'.

плевать.gloss: not to care, couldn't care less (+ dative)

meanings.en: couldn't care less, don't care (colloquial predicative: мне плевать на + accusative)

examples.text: Если тебе плевать на дочь, то мне нет!
examples.trans: If you don't care about our daughter, I do!

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)
meanings.note: Мы поедем = We'll be off. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ехать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (by vehicle), to set off', paired with 'ехать'.

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понимать'.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
